description: Digitized building footprints from VHR Worldview3 satellite image is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Franz Okyere. This data was generated from randomly selected square patches from the extents of a high-resolution Worldview3 satellite image (2023) for the Ashaiman district, Accra, Ghana. The patches were digitised by an expert in the fields of cartography, surveying, and GIS. Coverage: national (GH); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
